row: Swedish Massage Techniques for Students Only

Hello, my name is Ximena Baca, LMT, MAED, MSAHPI. I am a professor of Massage Therapy as well as Anatomy & Physiology courses at Miami Dade, Florida. I have been a licensed Massage Therapist in the State of Florida since 2003. I hold a Master's degree in Adult Education and Training, along with a Master's degree in Instructional Anatomy & Physiology. I am also on my second year of my Doctoral Degree in Adult education and Leadership with a minor in Technology. I project to graduate December 2025. 

The purpose of this channel is to inspire students to develop a foundational understanding of Swedish Massage techniques. The term "SAALBIS" reflects my passion for education and draws from my personal academic journey to motivate students toward success in their professional studies.
(SAALBIS stands for: Start, Achieve, Attain, Live, Believe, Inspire, and Succeed).
Let's do this!!
